entries.title: Merge buttons, batch updates and the secret approval card speak your language
entries.body: In a language other than English, the merge button on a change's card, the Activity lines about your batches, the line saying a change merged with its batch, and the card asking to give a secret to a task now show in your language. The GitLab sign-in steps also name GitLab's own fields in your language, and a custom API saved without a name takes its default name in your language.
entries.noPicture: Every view keeps its layout and English stays word for word the same; only the words change in the other languages.
